tips.detail: On 19–20 September 2026, park free at Jiggers Bank and use unlimited hop-on/hop-off Park & Ride through the Gorge for £2 per adult. Under-16s and concessionary pass holders travel free.

Southwater Multi-Storey is open 24 hours and is the closest main car park. Dark Lane and Brown Elm are also nearby. Official council information lists disabled parking bays in the surrounding car parks.
The Festive Gardens trail is step free, but the official listing warns that it includes gradual hills and mixed terrain, which may matter for wheelchair users, mobility aids and pushchairs.
Shrewsbury Bus Station is around a 10-minute walk from The Quarry; Shrewsbury Railway Station is around a 15-minute walk. The organiser encourages public transport for the event.
